detaileddescription.para: Build a SpdlogLoggerAdapter backed by a null sink (no I/O, measures pure formatting and dispatch overhead).

briefdescription.para: Performance benchmarks for DI overhead and logging throughput (Issue #1420).

detaileddescription.para:
Measures:
ConcernsContext creation cost (NoOp and custom variants)
NoOpLogger throughput (baseline — zero-overhead floor)
SpdlogLoggerAdapter throughput with null sink (plain-text and JSON modes)
Structured log (logStructured) throughput with field maps
logWithContext throughput (trace/span ID injection)
ConcernsContext convenience logging wrappers (logInfo / logError)
NoOpMetrics counter/histogram overhead
NoOpCache get/put overhead via ConcernsContext (dispatch-only baseline)
InMemoryCacheImpl get-hit, get-miss, and put throughput (real LRU)
